copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成带图表和筛选器的数据看板。
copy.tagline_en: Generate interactive data dashboard HTML pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create a data dashboard with charts and filters.

howto.what: 生成一个暗色主题的交互式HTML仪表板，包含KPI卡片、图表、过滤器和排序表格，可直接在浏览器中打开。
howto.when: 当你需要将数据转为可视化报告，或要求创建含多个图表和过滤器的执行摘要时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个月度营收和用户增长仪表板。
用Stripe数据生成带过滤器的KPI看板。
创建一个团队监控仪表板，数据从CSV导入。

howto.what_en: Generates an interactive HTML dashboard with KPI cards, charts, filters, and sortable tables, using Evolution dark theme. Opens directly in browser; no server needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need an executive overview with KPI cards, to turn query results into a shareable report, or to build a monitoring snapshot with multiple charts and filters.

say_en.text: Create a dashboard with monthly revenue and user growth.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the corresponding HTML file.

say_en.text: Build a KPI dashboard with filters using Stripe data.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch data via int-stripe.

say_en.text: Make a team monitoring dashboard with CSV data.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the CSV and embed it.
